actions: Native weapon filter click from all-items page 0
Native next-page click from weapon page 0 to page 1
protocol.clock: Trusted click capture listener to the second requestAnimationFrame callback. UI handlers, rendering and observed frame delay included; protocol transport and correctness checks excluded.
protocol.quantile: Sorted rank floor((n-1)*p). Paired differences use current minus baseline. Only the fixed warmups are excluded. No tail removal, adaptive sample count or retry replacement.
protocol.lifecycle: One Chromium process; a fresh context and real native main/mirror save for each scheduled entry. Filter then page always in this declared order. Contexts never overlap.
protocol.correctness: Each complete inventory section is compared with its own source center(state,ui), parsed by native DOMParser. Card IDs, actions, text and all attributes are retained. Complete persisted bytes and decoded state including RNG are unchanged; primary and mirror must be identical.
limits: Synthetic fixed 10000-item inventory; not natural-player distribution.
Software ANGLE SwiftShader and browser callback latency; not physical GPU FPS, disk durability or a save-transaction speed claim.
No engine, storage, quota, Web Locks, handler or animation API is replaced.
